test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six teachers are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). C is an immediate neighbour of both A and F. E is sitting second to the left of F. D is sitting fourth to the left of C. A is sitting second to the right of F. Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: D is to the immediate right of E.
F and D are immediate neighbours.
B is immediate right of F.
B is immediate left of F.

solution: Given: Six teachers are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is sitting second to the right of F. E is sitting second to the left of F. C is an immediate neighbour of both A and F. D is sitting fourth to the left of C.
